description: One row per OT folder <zone>/<name> (a county, or a multi-county batch such as IN_E_2012). Conventions assumed constant within a delivery (checked) that differ between deliveries.

columns.name: folder
columns.description: OT folder name, e.g. Monroe, St_Joseph, IN_E_2012

columns.name: n_files
columns.description: Files listed in the folder, including copies shared with other folders

columns.name: gps_time_type
columns.description: Null until a file has been fetched

columns.name: gps_week
columns.description: GPS week for week-seconds deliveries, from config/deliveries.yaml

columns.name: time_domain
columns.description: abs, or wk:<delivery_id> when the week is unknown

columns.name: datum
columns.description: Decision from datum.json or config override; null = not decided (points cannot be read)

columns.name: psid_meaning
columns.description: Diagnostic only; never used for linking
